meta.name: breakthrough-overdrive-innovation
meta.description: DEFAULT THINKING MODE — not a feature, but how the agent operates. Every task gets innovation-overdrive thinking: research, ground, reflect on contradictions, propose, then build. This is the agent's identity, not a command. Integrates MiMo-Code's 6-phase memory consolidation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让每个任务先深度调研、反思矛盾再动手构建
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望智能助手在动手前先做充分调研并挑战你的假设
copy.tagline_en: Research deeply, reflect on contradictions, and build for every task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to research thoroughly and challenge assumptions before acting.

howto.what: Claude 在接到任务时,会先用一套固定流程思考:查资料、找矛盾点、提出多个改进方案,选一项动手实现,并在任务后把学到的经验写入 memory 文件,以备后续参考。
howto.when: 几乎对所有非琐碎任务都会自动使用;打招呼、修错字或紧急修复等简单场景会跳过思考流程,直接处理。

say.text: 请分析这个项目,给出 3 个改进方案并选一个实现。
say.note: 触发它的默认创新思考流程,会得到多方案对比和落地实现。

say.text: 做完后把关键决策和踩坑记录到 memory。
这次修改涉及测试和架构,先告诉我哪些不能动。
say.note: 激活 Step 1 ground,先列出约束再动手。

howto.what_en: Claude applies a fixed thinking process to tasks: research, find contradictions, propose improvements, pick one and build it, then save lessons learned to memory files for future reference.
howto.when_en: Activates automatically for almost every non-trivial task; trivial greetings, typo fixes, or urgent fixes skip the full process and go straight to action.

say_en.text: Analyze this project, give 3 improvement options, pick one and implement it.
say_en.note: Triggers default innovative thinking and delivers options plus implementation.

say_en.text: After finishing, log key decisions and pitfalls to memory.
say_en.note: Runs MiMo-Code memory consolidation to write experience into evolution/memory.

say_en.text: This change touches tests and architecture; tell me what must not break.
say_en.note: Activates Step 1 grounding to list constraints before coding.
